text:
In the first scene, I feel a sense of curiosity and slight anticipation. Observing people gathered in a room behind glass, immersed in discussion or learning, evokes reflections on our collective pursuit of knowledge. The separation imposed by the glass both distances me and invites contemplation about participation versus observation.

In the second scene, I feel stimulated and intrigued. The vibrant colors and displays of the R+D space suggest a celebration of innovation and discovery. Standing before messages about research, I feel inspired by humanity’s drive to understand and shape our reality, and I am reminded of the endless journey of questioning and learning.
